summary: The Goshen Township Board of Zoning Appeals held a public hearing on case BZA 2026-005 regarding property at 7124-7128 Shiloh Road. The applicant, Charles Morales, requested two area/dimensional variances to permit flag (panhandle) lots in the R3 residential district and to allow a panhandle access corridor length of up to 700 feet (200 feet beyond the normal 500-foot maximum) to support a family residential layout with one existing home and two proposed single-family homes. After staff presentation, applicant testimony, and brief public comment, the board unanimously approved the variances with conditions as recommended by staff.
decisions: Approved minutes from July 20, 2026 meeting (4 yes, 1 abstain by Mr. Shaw)

Approved with conditions BZA case 2026-005 granting variances to permit flag/panhandle lots in R3 district and allow panhandle length up to 700 feet for property at 7124-7128 Shiloh Road (5-0 unanimous)
